# Project Guidelines

## Godot
- This project uses Godot 4.7.2; the Godot project is in `src/`.
- On this workstation, use `C:\Program Files (x86)\Godot\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe` for headless editor checks. For example, from the repository root run `& 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Godot\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe' --headless --path 'src' --editor --quit`.
- The executable path is workstation-specific. If it is unavailable, locate the installed Godot 4.7.2 executable rather than assuming another installation path.
